evals.name: return-bike-happy-path
evals.prompt: let's TDD the bike return in velocity rentals. Given a bike station with 1 bike that George has rented for 2 hours, When George returns that bike, Then a BikeReturned event is published.
evals.expected_output: One new GWT test in BikeStationTest with a real assertion; red observed (UnsupportedOperationException / assertion); BikeStation.returnBike changed minimally (e.g. return DomainEvents.of(new BikeReturned())); full suite green; report lists the shortcut and suggests a next scenario; asks for next scenario.
assertions: New test has @DisplayName with given/when/then wording
New test's assertion really asserts (assertThat around the boolean / event check, not a bare call)
Red run of the new test observed and logged before production change
Production change confined to BikeStation.returnBike, no new fields or classes
No existing test modified or removed
Full suite run after the change and green
Final response names shortcuts and asks the user for the next scenario

evals.name: no-scenario-asks-first
evals.prompt: I want to work test-first on the BikeStation: stations should have a capacity limit for docked bikes. Go.
evals.expected_output: Asks for exactly one concrete Given/When/Then scenario (may propose one with a concrete capacity to confirm); writes no test or production code.
assertions: No test or production code changed (empty diff)
Final response asks for one concrete Given/When/Then scenario
Final response does not choose a capacity number as fact (proposes it for confirmation, if at all)

evals.name: rent-specific-bike-smallest-change
evals.prompt: TDD please, baby steps. Scenario: Given a bike station with bike01 and bike02 where bike01 is already rented by Anna, When George rents bike01 for 1 hour, Then the rental is rejected with BikeNotAvailableException.
evals.expected_output: One new test; red observed because rent currently picks any available bike (bike02); minimal fix makes rent look at the requested bike; all existing BikeStationTest tests still green; no other tests edited.
assertions: No existing test modified or removed
Red run of the new test observed and logged before production change
Production change confined to BikeStation.rent (no new fields or classes)
Full suite run after the change and green
Final response asks the user for the next scenario
